projects.name: Gruber 🕊️
projects.description: Realtime Markdown-to-slides presentation engine. Built a custom lexer, tokenizer, and AST parser completely from scratch with zero dependencies in native JavaScript.

projects.name: TypeRush 🪐
projects.description: Real-time multiplayer typing duel engine built with a custom WebSocket architecture. Features room-based matchmaking, synchronized race countdowns, live opponent cursor/progress tracking, and instant WPM analytics.

projects.name: nslookup in C
projects.description: Command-line DNS resolver written from scratch in C using the UNIX Sockets API. Crafts 512-byte RFC 1035 wire datagrams, connects to UDP port 53, parses 12-byte header bitfields, and unpacks recursive A/AAAA records.

projects.name: http-server-cpp
projects.description: Lightweight multithreaded HTTP/1.1 server implementation from scratch in modern C++, supporting concurrent POSIX socket connections, request headers parsing, and static file streaming.

writings.title: Building a Custom HTTP Server from Scratch in C++
